title: German publisher C.H.BECK takes a majority stake in Noxtua, which develops AI tech to research, analyze, and draft legal documents and raised a $100M+ Series C (Cate Lawrence/Tech.eu)
summary: Cate Lawrence / Tech.eu: German publisher C.H.BECK takes a majority stake in Noxtua, which develops AI tech to research, analyze, and draft legal documents and raised a $100M+ Series C — The German legal AI company is deepening its ties with European publishers as it expands across the continent and takes on US competitors.
